observations.why: Present-tense 'we're switching' performs the migration as a settled, load-bearing action the speaker expects others to follow.
Flat unhedged assertion of benefits, asserted and ready to defend but moveable with evidence — no ratification or operational language.
Arrow notation records the migration as a settled transition, performing the decision rather than arguing for it.
Flat benefit assertion without ratification or operational language — claim-level, not decision-grade.
Specific timeline commitment anchors the migration as settled and load-bearing — the speaker commits to a concrete operational date.
